name: SMF Export
description: The pattern as a Standard MIDI File (type 1, 96 PPQ, one track per track with a note, the tempo and 4/4 first) in AppExport/smfexport/ on the card: the Pattern F7 TOOLS block, or the whole pattern. Micro-move is exported; other FX are counted, not written. A MIDI instrument keeps its channel. F1 EXPORT. New Community OS behaviour.
